translations.web: “ ‘ “How weak is your heart,” says the Lord Yahweh, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;
translations.bsb: How weak-willed is your heart, declares the Lord GOD, while you do all these things, the acts of a shameless prostitute!
translations.kjv: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an imperious whorish woman;
translations.asv: How weak is thy heart, saith the Lord Jehovah, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of an impudent harlot;
